entries.zh: 灶灰，锅底积的烟炱（黑烟灰）。
entries.en: soot; the black soot that gathers on a stove or the bottom of a pot.
fragrance, scent, pleasant smell; (also) odour, smell.

entries.zh: 排草：一种带香气的草，随身佩带以取其香味。
entries.en: a fragrant herb carried on the person for its scent; sweet-smelling grass (paitshau).
to forget; to lose from memory.
entries.notes: M 栏作 bông bông gī jî̃t jû 五音节，疑为词头连缀例句而残损，整句未能复原；释义依 source_L olvidar 与 H「忘」定。

entries.zh: 疏忽，因匆忙而忘事、大意。
entries.en: to forget or overlook in one's haste; to be careless, to neglect.
entries.notes: M 栏「hông huy」重复两次，疑为例句或连绵词残迹；释义依 L（olvidarse con la priesa）与 H「忽」定。
H 栏作「悖[疑:悖/悸]」、M 栏仅存「Que.」一音节、L 栏 oluidarse del consid… 残乱，四栏不足以定夺语义。

entries.zh: 失收：应当收而未收，漏收；因遗忘而未及收成。
entries.en: to fail to gather in, to miss collecting (a harvest, goods); to lose by neglect.

entries.zh: 荒废：因荒疏、遗忘而废弃（田地、事务等）。
entries.en: to neglect and let go to ruin; to lay waste, to abandon (land, work).

entries.notes: H 栏「落清[疑:清/凊]」与 M 栏「lõ cau」不相合，L 栏 of.le 为缩写且句义残乱，未能定夺。

entries.zh: 消化；引申为消解、淡忘（忧愁、不快）。
entries.en: to digest; figuratively to dissipate, to get over (grief, trouble).
entries.notes: L 栏作「旋即忘却忧愁」，H/M 为「消化」，此处取消解、淡忘之喻义，属推断。

entries.zh: 忘形骸：忘却自身形体，谓忘乎所以、失态。
entries.en: to forget one's own bodily frame; to be carried away, to lose all sense of self.
entries.notes: L 栏西语残乱（ponillar en wota cota），释义依 H「忘形骸」与 M 定。

entries.zh: 忘情：忘却所受恩情，不知感恩。
entries.en: to forget a kindness received; to be ungrateful.
entries.notes: L 栏「oluidarse del Beneficio, y de dar gracias」明指忘恩不谢，故取此义而非「不动情」。
